bird.en: An animal with wings and feathers that can often fly.

sparrow.en: A small brown bird that often lives near people and gardens.

garden.en: A place outdoors where people grow flowers, plants, or food.

seeds.en: Tiny parts of a plant that can grow into a new plant if they are cared for.

seed.en: A tiny part of a plant that can grow into a new plant.

flower.en: The colorful part of a plant that often has a sweet smell.

flowers.en: The colorful parts of plants that often have a sweet smell.

path.en: A small road or track that people walk along.

morning.en: The early part of the day, after night and before noon.

window.en: An opening in a wall that you can look through.

leaves.en: The flat green parts that grow on plants and trees.

branch.en: A part of a tree that grows out from the trunk.

visitor.en: Someone who comes to see a place or a person for a short time.

fluttered.en: Moved quickly by flapping wings in short, light motions.

hopped.en: Jumped forward in small, quick jumps.

pecked.en: Hit something lightly with a beak.

smiled.en: Made a happy look with the mouth.

school.en: A place where children go to learn.

teacher.en: A person who helps students learn.

friend.en: A person you like and enjoy spending time with.

family.en: The people who are closest to you at home.

water.en: The clear liquid we drink and that fills rivers and rain.

river.en: A long stream of water that flows across the land.

tree.en: A tall plant with a trunk, branches, and leaves.

sun.en: The bright star that lights and warms the day.

moon.en: The round light we often see in the night sky.

book.en: Pages with words or pictures that you can read.

story.en: A tale about people, animals, or places.

apple.en: A round fruit that is often red or green.

food.en: What people and animals eat to live and grow.

plant.en: A living thing that grows in soil, like a flower or a tree.

plants.en: Living things that grow in soil, like flowers or trees.

rain.en: Drops of water that fall from the clouds.

night.en: The dark time when the sun is gone.

day.en: The time when it is light outside.
